tool_input.content:
# Project Template

This is a POC Builder project. The following files are automatically generated:

- `booth.project.json` - Project metadata
- `booth.log.jsonl` - Event log (JSONL format)
- `features.json` - Feature list and status

## Project Structure

```
project-slug/
├── booth.project.json   # Metadata (ideaId, slug, token, timestamps)
├── booth.log.jsonl      # Event log (JOB_CREATED, JOB_STARTED, etc.)
├── features.json        # Features with status tracking
├── README.md            # This file
└── src/                 # Source code (to be generated)
```

# Orchestrator Service Configuration
# Copy this file to .env and fill in the values

# ======================
# Required Configuration
# ======================

# Intake API Base URL (e.g., http://localhost:3000 for local development)
INTAKE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3002

# Authentication key for communicating with Intake API
# Must be at least 16 characters
ORCH_KEY=qwerty1234567890

# ======================
# Optional Configuration
# ======================

# Server port (default: 3001)
PORT=3001

# Environment (development, production, test)
NODE_ENV=development

# Log level (debug, info, warn, error)
LOG_LEVEL=info

# Queue Service Configuration (all values in milliseconds)

# Cache TTL - How long cached data is considered fresh (default: 30000 = 30 seconds)
# QUEUE_CACHE_TTL=30000

# Stale Threshold - Age after which cache is considered stale (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)
# QUEUE_STALE_THRESHOLD=300000

# Refresh Interval - Background refresh interval (default: 30000 = 30 seconds)
# QUEUE_REFRESH_INTERVAL=30000

# Retry Interval - How long to wait before retrying after an error (default: 60000 = 60 seconds)
# QUEUE_RETRY_INTERVAL=60000

# Intake Client Configuration

# API Timeout - Request timeout in milliseconds (default: 10000 = 10 seconds)
# INTAKE_API_TIMEOUT=10000

# Path to where projects will be created
PROJECTS_WORKSPACE_PATH=/path/to/workspace

# Path to the project template directory
PROJECT_TEMPLATE_PATH=/path/to/template
